The '''Corellian Assembly''' was a senatorial body that guided the government within the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] System following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Representation within the body was determined by popular vote with membership comprising of individuals from the prominent political factions; namely the [[Democratic Alliance]], the [[Corellian Liberal Front]] and the [[Centerpoint Party]]. There were also additional independent representatives that gained seats through the various elections.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

Ten years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] vasion of the galaxy, the Assembly became a location of an intense power struggle where the representatives of the various factions sought to block the extremist views of [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]. Sal-Solo had threatened to go to war with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] unless they were given independence which was an action that many believed would bring about huge losses to Corellia. This in turn led to the start of the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Corellian Insurrection]] where the Galactic Alliance set up a bloackade around the Corellian system. Many of the members of the Assembly feared that Sal-Solo's efforts had resulted in further hardship for all Corellians but after his assassination, the various parties worked together to create a coalition government.<ref name="Bloodlines" />
